text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Eeek! It's Super Creek! Mommy, I'm scared!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Grrrr! I'll eat you up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Eeeeep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek's notoriety grows to rival Oguri Cap's popularity.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling, Super Creek? What's your outlook for the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, both Tamtam and Oguri are trying their best, but they've still got a ways to go. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No matter how much they struggle, they won't win. Hehehe, the world is mine. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: In all seriousness, how do you see the middle and long-distance Nakayama races playing out?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, don't things seem strange to you lately?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm doing my part to play the villain, but everyone's so indifferent.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Look, it's Creek! Over there! See?

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Oooh, you're right! She's so fast and strong! Creeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: See what I mean?
choice_data_list: Maybe they're starting to see you differently.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the beginning, she was simply Oguri Cap's rival. But as she gets more exposure…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps people, both fans and non-fans alike, are starting to see Super Creek for who she really is.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, how complicated. I don't mind being the villain though. It's kind of fun.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm happy as long as everyone is enjoying themselves.
choice_data_list: Maybe people want to see you in a different role.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: A different role? You mean as something other than a villain?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I'm not sure if I can just switch things up on the fly.
choice_data_list: I believe you already have another character up your sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Another character? By that, do you mean…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone has begun to realize that Super Creek doesn't have to act like a super athlete—because she already is one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The winds of change have started howling in the lead-up to the end-of-year showdown.
